result.rationale: The model's validation regex explicitly allows a port suffix: /\A[a-z0-9]+([\-\.]{1}[a-z0-9]+)*\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(\/.*)?\Z/i, and before_validation only strips the scheme and path (not the port), so 'example.com:8080' would be stored verbatim. record_for_host, however, compares where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host) and Ruby's URI#host never includes the port, so a stored 'example.com:8080' cannot match the 'example.com' extracted from a referer — embedding then fails silently with no diagnostic. Mechanism and both code sites are directly visible in the diff.
